These are practical and large shelves. The criticism I do have which is fair and honest is that the photos advertising the shelves on the Vevor website are of a much more solid unit. The vertical poles shown are of a significantly larger diameter. This is both misleading and unnecessary. If the product that is being sold cannot be represented accurately then don't sell it.

Degelijk ding, met inderdaad perforaties in het onderblad om de reststoom af te voeren en een natte plank te voorkomen.
